description: Follow a URL hop by hop: every redirect with status (301/302/307/308), Location, response time and server, the final URL and status, all response headers, security headers present (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options...) and plain-English issues (too many hops, 302 instead of 301, no http->https). Live, ~1 s. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/redirect-checker.
